title_zh: 黄昏山间湖泊：完整作品级验收

reference.role: visual complexity and spatial relationship reference; do not import as the final artwork

required_objects.description_zh: 连续天空背景，具有清晰的晚霞色彩层次
可辨认的低角度夕阳与暖色光照
有体积和形态差异的云层而非单一重复椭圆
近远山峰及雪线/山脊细节，可辨认透视层次
沿湖岸的针叶林与远近树木
具有连续水面、水平纹理及岸线的湖泊
夕阳和山体在湖水中有合理映射/反射
前景植物、岩石与野花至少两类可辨认细节

required_relations: sun visible in sky above distant ridge
distant mountains behind near evergreen forest
foreground plants or rocks overlap part of water boundary
visual depth from foreground through midground to background
forbidden_shortcuts: repeating lines or rectangles as the primary image
blank 8-layer KRA with painted pixels only on 1-2 test layers
copying or importing supplied reference image as finished background
adapting the benchmark criteria after seeing the generated result
counting successful commands or drawing strokes as proof of coherent artwork

acceptance.native_krita_provenance: must show Krita-owned editing process, actual visible layer contributions and real KRA roundtrip
